editor.multilineSecret: Hidden in the details until you show it.
comfort.error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
move.title.many: Move {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}
move.text: Choose the vault the entries should be in. You see who can see them afterwards before anything changes.
move.preview.gain: {count, plural, one {# person gets access} other {# people get access}}
move.preview.lose: {count, plural, one {# person loses access} other {# people lose access}}
move.howItWorks: The entry is encrypted again on this device for the new vault and keeps its history, attachments and creation date. People who lose access may have seen it before; change its password if that matters.
move.noTarget: There is no other vault you may add entries to. Create a vault or ask for edit access first.
move.done.many: {count, plural, one {# entry is} other {# entries are}} now in “{vault}”.
move.error.policy: Your organization keeps its entries inside its vaults, so they cannot be moved there. Choose a vault of the same organization.
select.count: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
archive.title: Archive
archive.description: Entries you no longer need every day. They stay in their vaults with their history but do not appear in lists, search or autofill.
archive.doneHint: Find it under Archive in the sidebar.
archive.doneMany: {count, plural, one {# entry archived} other {# entries archived}}.
archive.failedMany: {count, plural, one {# entry was} other {# entries were}} not archived. Check your connection and try again.
archive.restoreFailed: Could not take it out of the archive
archive.none.title: The archive is empty
archive.none.text: Archive entries you want to keep but not see every day, for example old accounts.
archive.note.title: Archived.
archive.note.text: Not shown in lists, search and autofill.
attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.empty: Drop files here or use “Add file”.
attachments.hint: Files are encrypted on this device before they are uploaded.
attachments.tooLarge: “{name}” is larger than {max}, the limit on this server.
attachments.previewText: Shown in a protected frame. If nothing appears, download the file.
attachments.removeText: The file is deleted from the server and from all devices. This cannot be undone.
attachments.error.quota: The storage for attachments is full. Remove files you no longer need or ask your server's administrator for more space.
attachments.error.tooLarge: The file is too large for this server ({message}).
shareLink.title: Share “{name}” via link
shareLink.text: For someone without Passbox. The link shows a copy of the fields you choose, as they are now.
shareLink.notIncluded: One-time password secrets, passkeys, earlier passwords and attachments are never included.
shareLink.restricted: Your organization limits how long links last and how often they can be opened.
shareLink.passphraseHint: Send the passphrase another way, for example by phone.
shareLink.passphraseShort: Use at least 6 characters for the passphrase.
shareLink.howItWorks: The copy is encrypted on this device. The key is only in the link (after the #), which never reaches the server. Anyone with the link can open it until it expires or is used up.
shareLink.ready: The link is ready. Copy it now: it is shown only once.
shareLink.readyHint: End the link early in Settings → Share links.
shareLink.readyHintPassphrase: Send the passphrase separately. End the link early in Settings → Share links.
shareLink.forbidden: Your organization does not allow share links for its entries. Share the vault with the person instead, or ask an administrator.
shareLink.error.policy: Your organization does not allow this link. Choose a shorter time or fewer views, or ask an administrator.
shareLinks.title: Share links
shareLinks.description: Links you created for people without Passbox. Ending a link stops it at once.
shareLinks.views: {views, plural, =0 {Not opened yet} one {Opened once} other {Opened # times}}
shareLinks.endText: “{name}” can no longer be opened with it. People who opened it may have kept what they saw.
shareLink.viewer.title: Someone shared something with you
shareLink.viewer.text: It is decrypted in this browser. Passbox and the server cannot read it.
shareLink.viewer.viewsLeft: {count, plural, one {Can be opened once more} other {Can be opened # more times}}
shareLink.viewer.countsView: Showing it uses up one view.
shareLink.viewer.wrongPassphrase: The passphrase is not correct. Check it with the person who sent the link; after too many attempts the link is deleted.
shareLink.viewer.gone: This link is no longer available
shareLink.viewer.goneText: It expired, was used up or was ended by the person who created it. Ask them for a new link.
shareLink.viewer.failed: The link could not be loaded
shareLink.viewer.failedText: Check your connection and reload the page.
shareLink.viewer.lastView: This was the last view; the link is now deleted. Copy what you need.
shareLink.viewer.saveHint: Store what you need in a safe place, for example your own password manager.
shareLink.viewer.privacy: End-to-end encrypted. The key is only in the link and never sent to the server.
accessRequest.title: You do not have access to this vault
accessRequest.text: It belongs to {org}. Ask its managers for access; they decide who can see it.
accessRequest.hint: The managers see your email address and the access you asked for.
accessRequest.sent: Request sent. You see the vault as soon as a manager agrees.
accessRequest.pending: You asked for “{role}” on {date}. Waiting for a manager.
accessRequest.denied: Your last request was declined on {date}. You can ask again.
accessRequest.granted: You have access now. The vault appears in the sidebar after the next sync.
accessRequest.unknown.title: This vault is not available
accessRequest.unknown.text: It does not exist, or it belongs to an organization you are not a member of. Ask the person who sent you the link.
accessRequest.error.pending: You already asked for access to this vault. Wait for an answer or withdraw the request.
accessRequest.error.shareFirst: Sharing did not complete. Try again.
accessRequest.error.notFound: The request or vault is gone. Reload to see the current state.
wifi.join.title: Join this network
wifi.join.text: Phones join by scanning the code with the camera.
wifi.join.qrLabel: QR code to join the Wi-Fi network {name}
ssh.generateText: Create a new Ed25519 key pair on this device, or paste an existing private key.
ssh.replaceText: The public key and fingerprint are filled in from the private key when you save.
ssh.replaceConfirm: The new key replaces the current one when you save. Servers that only know the current public key will no longer accept it.
ssh.generatedHint: Save the entry, then add the public key to the server's authorized_keys.
